answer: A scripted farm as a result has to pad 166 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. Because the timing is written down against the vine challenge, the comet audit can replay the echo history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 3 epochs. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
